name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: The player with the Maple set belongs to the Evening Study Group.
Magnus, Slav, Pin, and Arabian belong to different players.
The player known for the Boden's mate belongs to the Morning Study Group.
The player known for the Hook mate and the player known for the Smothered mate are in different study groups.
The player with the Glass set does not belong to the Morning Study Group.
Vera goes with neither Maple nor Pewter.
Magnus goes with exactly two of Caro-Kann, Maple, and Boden's.
Anatoly, Pirc, Rosewood, and Smothered belong to different players.
Anatoly and Magnus are in different camps.
The player who loves the Zwischenzug does not belong to the King's-Pawn Camp.
